scope: Parts 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6A, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 12 - every operative Part of the Act except Part 1 (preliminary), Part 11 (repealed) and Parts 13 to 16 (inspection, general, and the final provisions). Within those Parts, not encoded: s 19, s 34, s 39, ss 41-41A, ss 47-53, s 66 (registration of contractors), ss 70-75, ss 84-87A (dismissal before confinement, contracting out, childcare leave), s 90, and ss 97-101. PART 9 IS THE CURRENT LAW ONLY: s 76 carries three qualifying rules side by side for confinements before 1 May 2013, between then and 22 August 2015, and after; only the last is encoded, so a confinement before 22 August 2015 is outside this encoding entirely. Everything the Act leaves to be prescribed - record retention periods, pay slip timing, the Fifth Schedule reckoning, the minimum period of service under s 95A - is a fact supplied, and the regulations were not retrieved. Added 12 October 2026 for REQ-0289: s 96A (retrenchment information to the Commissioner) with ss 101(3), 102(5), 126A(aa), 126B(1)(aa), 126C(6) and 126D, in ea-part12-retrenchment.l4; the Gazette notification that fixes which retrenchments, the time, form and particulars was not retrieved and is a supplied fact. Added 12 October 2026 for REQ-0289, second pass: the Employment (Retrenchment Reporting) Notification 2019 (S 200/2019, version in force from 1 November 2021, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/EmA1968-S200-2019.txt) in ea-retrenchment-reporting-notification.l4 - covered employers (10 or more covered employees at the notice date) and employees (no end date, or a term of at least 6 months), 'retrench', the duty in para 3, the 5-working-day deadline in para 4 (public holidays supplied), the form in para 5 and the Schedule particulars; the version before 1 November 2021 was not deposited and is not encoded.
seat_inputs_note: Since 21 October 2026 every seat question takes plain, seat-worded inputs (yes/no, numbers, the modules' own choices), one per fact the person states, and builds the modules' records internally before calling the same rules. The seats assume the Act's own figures for what the Minister may substitute (ss 29, 30, 32 proportions, s 35 thresholds, the s 95A 14 days); a later substitution would change those answers. Before: employee 31 inputs (22 records, 103 fields on the form), employer 76 inputs (37 records, 229 fields).
